audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradict their reasons. whys[0] ends 'level 1-2 is a skill check, not her lane' under win[0]='Cassiopeia'; whys[3] says 'she chips you down across levels 4-5 faster than your sustain recovers' under 'Skill'; whys[5] ends 'her first item beats yours in a straight lane fight' under 'Skill'. The packet levelChart agrees with the prose on all three. Separately, diff was 'EVEN' while diffRating read 8.5/10, tone was the hard-matchup red, and report[14] called it a hard matchup.
audit.why: Level 1 neither can punish — she has only Noxious Blast, you have no stun. From 4 onward the poison ticks and Miasma's grounding compound, and her first item out-ranges yours.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 5 flipped in both layers with matching ratings; diff set to HARD to agree with the 8.5/10 rating, the red tone and report[14].

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma is tracked as the matchup-defining cooldown in five places but its number never appears, so 'engage on the Miasma gap' has nothing behind it.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — a 24-second rank-1 window is enormous, and it is the entire reason the level-3 punish exists. Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: The 24s rank-1 figure written into winCon and report[1].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. Twin Fang was written as 'Twin Fangs' in spikes[1].text (the packet flagged it), and nothing anywhere states that Twin Fang HEALS her for a percentage of the damage dealt — which is the reason a long trade against her fails even when you are on top of her. Petrifying Gaze's facing requirement is stated in the content layer but nowhere in the full layer's do's and don'ts.
audit.why: Riot's text: Twin Fang 'deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt'; Petrifying Gaze stuns 'any enemies in front of her that are facing her' and only slows those with their back turned. Miasma grounds, and grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities — that is what kills Bladesurge.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names Twin Fang correctly and states the heal; dosFull[2] rewritten to the facing rule; dontsFull[1] rewritten to the grounding; report[8] adds Executioner's for Twin Fang.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Cassiopeia 'he', 'him' and 'his' throughout — tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], report[2], report[11], report[12], breakdown.feeding, breakdown.wave, tradeGood and both don'ts.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is female; the content layer already uses 'she' correctly, so the two layers read as different champions.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every string I rewrote; the remainder listed in notes.
